title: LLaVA → DeepStack: how ViT embeddings enter the LM, in NumPy

paper.title: Improved Baselines with Visual Instruction Tuning (LLaVA-1.5)

summary: One walk-through of the vision → language bridge, in two problems. The ViT block and the LLaMA block are given (solved in the ViT pack). The bridge is what you write. 01 LLaVA: penultimate-layer patch features (no ln_post, no CLS), a 2-layer GELU MLP, splicing N tokens in place of the <image> id, RoPE positions over the spliced sequence, and a loss that ignores image slots. 02 DeepStack: the same low-res sequence, plus high-res tiles from the same ViT and projector, dilation-sampled into 4 stacks aligned with the low-res cells and residual-added at the visual positions before early LM layers (Alg. 1), with no extra context. LLaVA-1 and DeepStack papers are in refs/.

problems.title: LLaVA: from ViT patch features to LM input tokens
DeepStack: stack high-res tokens into the LM's early layers
concepts: residual add at vis_pos before layer idx
